points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata })` ... The flavour is a string with an `affine:` prefix, such as `affine:paragraph`. ... `metadata` holds the `version`, `role` (`content`, `hub` or `root`), and `parent` and `children` constraints.
`metadata` holds the `version`, `role` (`content`, `hub` or `root`), and `parent` and `children` constraints.
A model class extends `BlockModel`. Paragraph's is `ParagraphBlockModel`.

The view is a Lit custom element that extends `BlockComponent<Model>`. ... `renderChildren` renders child blocks. ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal`affine-paragraph`)` ... binds the flavour to its Lit tag
`WidgetViewExtension` (`std/src/extension/widget-view-map.ts`) attaches widgets to a block in the same way.
The editor takes the combined extension arrays, split into store and view, and the doc store and view manager read them.
